messages.subject: Re: Error in data.frame(out, as(newdata, "data.frame")) :   arguments imply differing number of rows: 808, 10
parts:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/27464893/getting-warning-newdata-had-1-row-but-variables-found-have-32-rows-on-pred

You fit the model using variable "grass200" but then tried predicting with a variable called "grass".  The newdata columns for prediction should match exactly to the variable names used to fit the model.
